name: 11412 · Saint Albans, NY
findings: ZIP 11412 (Saint Albans) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11412 (Saint Albans) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
98% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
